executiveSummary: Multiple high-impact OT/ICS advisories and active campaigns increase risk across water/wastewater, energy, manufacturing, and transportation. Priority actions are to remediate exposed management planes (VPN/virtualization), harden OT protocol edges (OPC UA, MQTT, S7comm), and patch or isolate vulnerable ICS components. Active multi-agency warning: adversaries are probing and interacting with Siemens S7 PLCs over S7comm (TCP/102) using AI-assisted tooling and public scanners. Immediate removal of internet exposure and strict control of PUT/GET are advised. CISA Advisory Unpatched MQTT client library flaw (libumqtt) can crash or corrupt memory on MQTT-enabled OT gateways/RTUs; no vendor fix yet-operators must segment MQTT traffic, enforce mutual TLS, and monitor for malformed packets. CISA ICS Advisory OpenPLC Runtime race condition allows unauthenticated creation of multiple admin users enabling controller takeover; update to 4.3.0 and review for rogue accounts. CISA ICS Advisory Advantech industrial gateways (LoRaWAN WISE-6610; EKI-1242 series) suffer remote command execution and unauthenticated control-block management ports, update firmware, and isolate from untrusted networks. CISA Weekly Supporting Weekly Danfoss iC7 drives issue enables unsigned application/firmware uploads-restrict service/update channels, enforce code-signing where possible, and monitor parameter/EEPROM integrity. CISA Weekly Ransomware groups continue to target virtualization/backup planes; recent incident shows full ESXi estates destroyed via legitimate management features-treat vCenter as Tier 0 and harden identity, logging, and SSH posture. View Article Perimeter exposure remains a key vector: SonicWall SSLVPN zero-day is in KEV; router hygiene advisories from CISA/partners cite state-backed exploitation of SNMP/Smart Install. KEV Notice Joint Advisory

vendors: Siemens S7 PLC families; Autonomy Logic OpenPLC Runtime; libumqtt (MQTT); Advantech WISE-6610 & EKI-1242 gateways; Danfoss iC7 drives; VMware vCenter/ESXi; SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN; NGINX HTTP/2; Eclipse Milo (OPC UA); Zimbra; multiple enterprise platforms in KEV (Cisco Expressway, VMware vCenter, SAP NetWeaver, Apache Roller).

items: Ransomware operations (SafePay, Gunra) continue to exploit VPNs, edge devices, and LOTL tools (Impacket, PsExec), with exfiltration to cloud storage before encryption-impacting IT that supports OT. SafePay Advisory Gunra Advisory

State-linked campaigns use covert residential/SOHO infrastructure and router misconfigurations to mask operations and pre-position access near critical networks. China-Nexus Advisory Russian Router Hygiene
Water/Wastewater red-team results demonstrate realistic IT→OT pivots via AD abuse, weak jump-host controls, and cloud identity misconfiguration. CISA Assessment

relevance: Current threats concentrate on: (1) direct PLC exposure and protocol abuse (S7comm), (2) core industrial messaging (MQTT/OPC UA) stack weaknesses, (3) edge gateway vulnerabilities enabling remote command and configuration changes, and (4) enterprise-to-OT pivot pathways through virtualization, backups, VPNs, and directory services. Safety and process integrity risks are highest where OT assets are internet-exposed or reachable from IT perimeters without robust segmentation and identity controls.

items: OPC UA (Eclipse Milo) flaws: authN/Z bypass, diagnostics exposure, and unauth DoS; disable weak Basic128Rsa15, set quotas/rate-limits. CISA Weekly
NGINX HTTP/2 RCEs (workaround: disable HTTP/2) until fully patched. CERT-FR Alert
ESXi/vCenter exploitation via legitimate features-treat virtualization as Tier 0, enforce MFA, off-host logs. View Article
Perimeter KEV: Cisco/VMware/SAP/Apache exploited in the wild-immediate patch & compromise checks. KEV Notice

descriptions: Protocol/Device Abuse: S7comm (TCP/102), MQTT (DoS/memory corruption), OPC UA (authN/Z bypass, diagnostics leakage).
Initial Access: Exploitation of public-facing applications (NGINX HTTP/2, Zimbra XSS), valid accounts via VPN portals (SonicWall), router management abuse (SNMP/Smart Install).
Execution/Persistence: Abuse of legitimate management features (vCenter/ESXi Host Profiles/SSH), OpenPLC rogue admin creation, gateway RCE on management ports.
Credential Access/Lateral Movement: Impacket, PsExec/WinRM, AD CS abuse, LSASS/NTLM capture; cloud identity misuse (Entra ID app consents, tokens).
Exfiltration/Impact: Cloud storage (Mega/OneDrive); destructive encryption of hypervisors and backups; OT risk via controller parameter/firmware manipulation.

outlook72h: Block and/or strictly filter TCP/102 and MQTT ingress/egress at OT perimeters; validate no S7comm exposure from the internet. Emergency review of virtualization/backup planes: confirm MFA on vCenter, disable unnecessary SSH, verify off-host logs, test restores. Implement deny-by-default ACLs to Advantech gateways; schedule firmware updates and rotate credentials. Deploy MQTT/OPC UA IDS signatures; baseline monitored-item creation rates and broker client churn. Run compromise assessment for SonicWall SSLVPN and other KEV-listed platforms; rotate secrets and tokens as needed.
